newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara to issue one bln rgt bills next week.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara to issue one bln rgt bills next week.

text.p: The Malaysian central bank announced on Thursday it will issue 91-day Bank Negara bills totalling one billion ringgit next week.
Results of the tender will be announced on Tuesday and the payment on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers said the issue will help to roll over 1.5 billion ringgit in Bank Negara bills maturing next week.
A one billion ringgit three-month bills issue will mature next Wednesday, followed by the maturity of a 500 million ringgit one-month bill issue on Friday.
Expectations of additional liquidity next week had pressured interbank rates lower this week, dealers said.
